english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a tap or faucet controlling water or another liquid.

exampleSentences.english: The kitchen tap is leaking, so get someone to fix it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 廚房個水喉漏水，快啲搵人嚟整啦。
